setup:
rabbitmqctl add_vhost shop
rabbitmqctl set_permissions -p shop guest ".*" ".*" ".*"
rabbitmqctl add_user web demo-pass
rabbitmqctl add_user packer demo-pass
rabbitmqctl set_permissions -p shop web "" "^orders$" ""
rabbitmqctl set_permissions -p shop packer "" "" "^pack-jobs$"
rabbitmqadmin --vhost shop exchanges declare --name orders --type direct --durable true
rabbitmqadmin --vhost shop queues declare --name packing --type classic --durable true
rabbitmqadmin --vhost shop bindings declare --source orders --destination-type queue --destination packing --routing-key pack
